added: In a move wording template, put a ! in front of a slot, like {!hand}, to always show it. A chain's hand, for example, is normally left out when the role implies it, but {who} {!hand} {move} still reads "robins right-hand chain".
Move wording templates accept `{!name}` slots, which force the slot to display even when it would otherwise be hidden (implied chain hand, alias-pinned params).
